shortDescription: Creates a resource of cce cluster in Huawei Cloud

options.name: access_key
options.description: Specifies the access key of the HuaweiCloud to use.

options.name: authenticating_proxy_ca
options.description: Specifies the CA root certificate provided in the authenticating_proxy mode. The CA root certificate is encoded to the Base64 format.

options.name: authentication_mode
options.description: Specifies the Authentication mode of the cluster, possible values are x509 and rbac.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Specifies the endpoint of the cloud. Required if you are using other cloud supported by Huaweicloud.

options.name: cluster_type
options.description: Specifies the cluster type, possible values are VirtualMachine, BareMetal and ARM64.

options.name: cluster_version
options.description: Specifies the cluster version, defaults to the latest supported version.

options.name: container_network_cidr
options.description: Specifies the container network segment.

options.name: container_network_type
options.description: Specifies the container network type.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies the cluster description.

options.name: eip
options.description: Specifies the EIP address of the cluster.

options.name: eni_subnet_cidr
options.description: Specifies the ENI network segment. Specified when creating a CCE Turbo cluster.

options.name: eni_subnet_id
options.description: Specifies the ENI subnet id. Specified when creating a CCE Turbo cluster.

options.name: enterprise_project_id
options.description: Specifies enterprise project id of the cce cluster.

options.name: extend_param
options.description: Specifies the extended parameter.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply when deciding whether existing resources match and should be altered. The item of filters is the name of input options.

options.name: flavor_id
options.description: Specifies the cluster specifications. cce.s1.small is small-scale single cluster (up to 50 nodes). cce.s1.medium is medium-scale single cluster (up to 200 nodes). cce.s1.large is large-scale single cluster (up to 1000 nodes). cce.s2.small is small-scale HA cluster (up to 50 nodes). cce.s2.medium is medium-scale HA cluster (up to 200 nodes). cce.s2.large is large-scale HA cluster (up to 1000 nodes). cce.t1.small is small-scale single physical machine cluster (up to 10 nodes). cce.t1.medium is med

options.name: identity_endpoint
options.description: Specifies the Identity authentication URL. Required if you are using other cloud supported by Huaweicloud.

options.name: kube_proxy_mode
options.description: Specifies the service forwarding mode. iptables: Traditional kube-proxy uses iptables rules to implement service load balancing. In this mode, too many iptables rules will be generated when many services are deployed. In addition, non-incremental updates will cause a latency and even obvious performance issues in the case of heavy service traffic. ipvs: Optimized kube-proxy mode with higher throughput and faster speed. This mode supports incremental updates and can keep connections uninterrupted

options.name: multi_az
options.description: Specifies whether enable multiple AZs for the cluster, only when using HA flavors.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the cluster.

options.name: project_id
options.description: Specifies the of ID of the project to login with.

options.name: region
options.description: Specifies the Huawei Cloud region.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: Specifies the secret key of the HuaweiCloud to use.

options.name: service_network_cidr
options.description: Specifies the service network segment.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud.

options.name: subnet_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the subnet used to create the node.

options.name: timeouts
options.description: The timeouts for each operations.

options.name: vpc_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the VPC used to create the node.
